WITH circuit_race_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    COUNT(*) as race_count
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.date >= '1978-03-04' AND r.date <= '2003-03-09'
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    AVG(race_count) as avg_race_count
  FROM circuit_race_counts
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT 
  crc.circuitId,
  crc.country,
  crc.race_count,
  CAST(crc.race_count AS FLOAT) / ca.avg_race_count as ratio
FROM circuit_race_counts crc
LEFT JOIN country_averages ca ON crc.country = ca.country
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
